# Browser dependencies

Fixed versions served from the same origin, downloaded 2026-11-18 from the npm packages via jsDelivr:

- ECharts 5.5.0: `echarts/dist/echarts.min.js` — Apache-2.0, see ECHARTS-LICENSE.
- SheetJS CE 0.18.5: `xlsx/dist/xlsx.full.min.js` — Apache-2.0, see XLSX-LICENSE.
- docx 8.5.0: `docx/build/index.umd.js` — MIT, see DOCX-LICENSE.

Preserve accompanying license files when deploying. Fonts are optional and fall back to local fonts.
